name: The Green Room (Saferoom B)
narrator_line: SAFEROOM CERTIFIED. Midterm Onboarding is complete. Level granted; fruit plate issued. Mandatory briefing follows.
read_aloud: SAFEROOM CERTIFIED. Midterm Onboarding is complete. Level granted; fruit plate issued. Mandatory briefing follows.

map.layout: A backstage green room: a mirror ringed with half-dead bulbs, folding chairs, a fruit plate that has become something else, a framed photo on the wall.
map.hazards: None; honest saferoom on Floor 1. Stays open to the end of the floor (house exception, inspired).

voice_lines.intro: SAFEROOM CERTIFIED. Midterm Onboarding is complete. Level granted; fruit plate issued. Mandatory briefing follows.
voice_lines.twist: The boxes all open at once, the way the System likes it: loud, public and a little embarrassing. Don't lose any of it.
voice_lines.win: Day closed. Zone schedule updates overnight. Long Rest recorded. Morning notice will list what remains open.
